_comments: Email body for the 'Task Completed' notification type. NotificationEngine renders it with the templateData the Tasks server passes: taskName, title, message. The email subject is the notification title.

fields.Name: MJ_BizApps_Tasks: Task Completed - Email
fields.Description: Email sent to a task's assignees when the task is marked completed. Rendered by MJ's NotificationEngine with { taskName, title, message }.

_comments: Email body for the 'Task Overdue' notification type. NotificationEngine renders it with the templateData the overdue job passes: taskName, title, message, dueDate, status, priority, isReminder (the body shows all but message). The email subject is the notification title.

fields.Name: MJ_BizApps_Tasks: Task Overdue - Email
fields.Description: Email sent to a task's assignees and creator when the task is past its due date, and again as a reminder when the task's notification config repeats. Rendered by MJ's NotificationEngine with { taskName, title, message, dueDate, status, priority, isReminder }.
